body:
Good morning!

Look out of your window: the first snow! The valley is all white and quiet.

The swallows have flown away south, but some little friends stay with us all winter. Come and find out who, in the grove behind the chapel.
summary: Find out which creatures stay for the winter.
done: Now you know who needs our help in winter!
